Tamil Nadu CM Vijay Engages in Public Appearances and Inspections

Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay has undertaken several public activities, including surprise inspections of government facilities and visits to districts. These appearances follow a period of legal challenges for his film and come after a stampede tragedy in Karur. His engagements highlight his administrative duties and public outreach efforts.
